feed.title: Useful Sites — new entries
feed.subtitle: A hand-curated, annotated link directory across ten areas, from software and AI to security, economics and architecture. Every entry states what the resource does and where it parts ways with its neighbours.

entry.title: Kitesurf
entry.content:
Experimental lightweight browser engine written in Rust to execute inside Cloudflare Workers; designed for edge runtime DOM parsing and rendering rather than heavy headless Chromium processes.

https://github.com/cloudflare/kitesurf

entry.title: Modern Web Guidance
entry.content:
Official Google Chrome skill repository that steers coding agents toward modern browser standards; promotes contemporary web platform primitives instead of relying on legacy polyfills and outdated patterns.

https://github.com/googlechrome/modern-web-guidance

entry.title: Web Interface Guidelines
entry.content:
Actionable interface design guidelines from Vercel Labs covering keyboard navigation, focus states, and layouts; emphasizes concrete practical implementation details rather than abstract aesthetic theory.

https://github.com/vercel-labs/web-interface-guidelines

entry.title: Playwright CLI
entry.content:
Official Microsoft command-line utility for common Playwright actions; records browser interactions and inspects selectors from the terminal rather than requiring handwritten initial test scripts.

https://github.com/microsoft/playwright-cli

entry.title: Agent Desktop
entry.content:
Lightweight CLI that enables AI agents to interact with desktop windows through screen capture and input simulation; operates directly on the native OS instead of requiring heavy virtual machine environments.

https://github.com/vercel-labs/agent-desktop

entry.title: Agent-Reach
entry.content:
Command-line tool giving AI agents the ability to search and read social platforms and the web; extracts clean structured content without recurring API fees instead of relying on costly platform tokens.

https://github.com/Panniantong/agent-reach

entry.title: Apify
entry.content:
Cloud platform and marketplace of ready-to-run web scrapers, crawlers, and data extraction actors; lets developers and agents invoke maintained scraping jobs instead of managing server farms from scratch.

https://apify.com/

entry.title: Archify
entry.content:
Agent skill for Claude Code and Codex that turns codebases and plans into interactive architecture diagrams; generates explorable browser visualizations rather than plain static image exports.

https://github.com/tt-a1i/archify

entry.title: claude-mem
entry.content:
Persistent memory engine that captures and compresses agent session activity to inject into future runs; preserves cross-session context locally instead of requiring complex external vector database setups.

https://github.com/thedotmack/claude-mem

entry.title: Emil Kowalski Skills
entry.content:
Agent skills focused on micro-interactions, motion design, and UI engineering craft; injects spring physics and fluid component details rather than stiff generic CSS transitions.

https://github.com/emilkowalski/skills

entry.title: Hallmark
entry.content:
Anti-slop design skill for Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex; guides agents away from generic purple gradients toward intentional typography and clean contrast instead of repetitive card grids.

https://github.com/Nutlope/hallmark

entry.title: Impeccable
entry.content:
Design vocabulary and critique skill for coding agents; reviews UI layouts and typography to intercept generic AI output before deployment instead of letting raw boilerplate reach production.

https://github.com/pbakaus/impeccable

entry.title: Julio Skills
entry.content:
Agent skill for Claude Code designed to build award-caliber web interfaces from concise briefs; steers agents toward distinct typographic rhythm and intentional craft rather than generic templates.

https://github.com/juliobsz/skills

entry.title: Marketing Skills
entry.content:
Growth engineering, copywriting, and CRO skills designed for Claude Code and coding agents; differs from purely technical agent tools by embedding conversion rate principles and landing page critique.

https://github.com/coreyhaines31/marketingskills

entry.title: Matt Pocock Skills
entry.content:
Collection of TypeScript-focused agent skills for Claude Code and Codex; relies on real-world engineering habits and type-driven refactoring workflows rather than abstract prompt templates.

https://github.com/mattpocock/skills

entry.title: Taste Skill
entry.content:
Agent skill that equips coding agents with art direction, visual references, and browser preview auditing; enforces visual polish and aesthetic judgment rather than generating bland standard layouts.

https://github.com/leonxlnx/taste-skill

entry.title: Auto Ontology
entry.content:
NVIDIA framework for building semantic, graph-based reasoning layers over data for LLMs; provides deterministic query generation and verifiable retrieval rather than relying solely on fuzzy vector similarity.

https://github.com/NVIDIA/auto-ontology

entry.title: AlphaSignal
entry.content:
Weekly summary that algorithmically ranks the most impactful papers, model weights, and open-source repositories; filters out social media noise to surface high-signal breakthroughs compared to raw feeds.

https://alphasignal.ai/

entry.title: Brag
entry.content:
Developer CLI tool that transforms newly built code repositories into short launch demo videos; generates shareable showcase clips automatically instead of requiring manual video editing workflows.

https://github.com/latent-spaces/brag

entry.title: Handy
entry.content:
Free, open-source speech-to-text desktop application that runs completely offline with local models; types dictated text via global hotkeys instead of transmitting audio to cloud providers.

https://github.com/cjpais/Handy

entry.title: Horizon
entry.content:
Self-hosted news radar that aggregates feeds and generates structured daily AI briefings; operates locally with custom LLM backends instead of depending on closed centralized newsletter services.

https://github.com/Thysrael/Horizon

entry.title: The Batch
entry.content:
Weekly artificial intelligence newsletter curated by Andrew Ng and the DeepLearning.AI editorial team; dives into research papers and industry implications rather than skimming hype-driven headlines.

https://www.deeplearning.ai/the-batch/

entry.title: TLDR AI
entry.content:
Concise daily newsletter summarizing major breakthrough models, research papers, and developer tools in artificial intelligence; delivers bite-sized insights instead of demanding hours of reading.

https://tldr.tech/ai

entry.title: ACE-Step
entry.content:
Open-weights foundation model for local music synthesis across consumer hardware; runs privately on CUDA, AMD, and Apple Silicon devices rather than gating audio behind closed proprietary APIs.

https://github.com/ace-step/ACE-Step-1.5

entry.title: Audio2Face-3D
entry.content:
NVIDIA models and toolchain generating expressive 3D facial animation and lip-sync motion directly from audio tracks; automates character rigging drives instead of requiring tedious manual keyframing.

https://github.com/NVIDIA/Audio2Face-3D

entry.title: Scenario Skills
entry.content:
Agent skills that drive Blender, Maya, Unity, and Unreal via the Scenario MCP for game asset pipelines; unlike general coding skills, it focuses specifically on 3D, texturing, and game production workflows.

https://github.com/scenario-labs/skills

entry.title: Teardown
entry.content:
Claude Code skill that turns machine descriptions into interactive 3D WebGL simulators with exploded views; provides explorable disassembled mechanisms unlike static CAD schematics.

https://github.com/elvarofficial/teardown

entry.title: Hackviser Hardening Tactics
entry.content:
System hardening and defensive configuration guide across operating systems and infrastructure services; unlike purely offensive manuals, it focuses on mitigation, policy enforcement, and audit steps.

https://hackviser.com/tactics/hardening

entry.title: Hackviser Pentesting Tactics
entry.content:
Practical penetration testing reference covering web vulnerabilities, protocols, and network services; provides structured attack workflows by service rather than unorganized command cheat sheets.

https://hackviser.com/tactics/pentesting

entry.title: Hackviser Tool Tactics
entry.content:
Quick reference for essential cybersecurity tools with practical command syntax and usage contexts; differs from standard man pages by grouping tools around actionable pentesting workflows.

https://hackviser.com/tactics/tools

entry.title: Oracle Certification
entry.content:
Official certification catalog and examination pathways for Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, database administration, and Java; verifies enterprise competence through vendor-standard assessments unlike third-party preparatory courses.

https://www.oracle.com/education/certification/

entry.title: Astryx
entry.content:
Open-source design system from Meta built on React 19 and StyleX; engineered for agentic workflows, offering modular composition rather than rigid monolithic component patterns.

https://github.com/meta/astryx

entry.title: ThreeUI
entry.content:
Curated showcase of Three.js 3D web components, interactive shaders, and scene templates; offers ready-to-use visual elements instead of writing complex WebGL shaders from scratch.

https://threeui.com/

entry.title: Nuvio
entry.content:
Modern media streaming and personal library player supporting multi-device sync and community addons; offers a lighter, cloud-synced interface compared to heavyweight self-hosted media server stacks.

https://nuvio.tv/

entry.title: AI Engineering from Scratch
entry.content:
Curriculum and repository teaching core AI engineering components from first principles in Python; builds tokenizers, vector retrieval, and agents step by step instead of relying on black-box wrappers.

https://github.com/rohitg00/ai-engineering-from-scratch

entry.title: AMD AI Academy
entry.content:
Official AMD developer learning portal for training and deploying models with ROCm and open frameworks; focuses on open hardware acceleration rather than proprietary vendor stacks.

https://developer.amd.com/amd-ai-academy/

entry.title: Bilgeİş
entry.content:
METU-backed (ODTÜ) open learning portal offering around a hundred free online courses in software, design, and digital literacy; unlike foreign MOOCs, it provides verified Turkish instruction with university certificates.

https://bilgeis.net/

entry.title: Classifyes LCSH
entry.content:
Search and translation utility for Library of Congress Subject Headings (LCSH) with Turkish mappings; unlike generic dictionaries, it specifically connects international bibliographic standards to local cataloguing terms.

https://classifyes.com/lcsh-translator/

entry.title: Kamu Personeli Alım İlanları
entry.content:
Official Turkish government portal for civil service and public sector job announcements; aggregates all ministry vacancies and recruitment exams in a single verified registry instead of fragmented institutional pages.

https://kamuilan.sbb.gov.tr/

entry.title: Tabby Terminal
entry.content:
Highly configurable cross-platform terminal emulator featuring integrated SSH, serial connection, and plugin support; offers rich session tabs and style customization unlike minimal system defaults.

https://tabby.sh/
